bindings.name: holder_commitment
bindings.source: envelope:holderBinding.commitment — MUST equal the envelope holder binding shared by every proof in the presentation.

bindings.name: claim_binding
bindings.note: compute_claim_binding_4(predicate_type, required_0, required_1, flag_required, proof_context, timestamp). flagRequired is an exact JSON boolean and defaults to false only when omitted. For non-accreditation meanings it MUST remain false. The preimage does NOT include set_root — recomputing this field never checks the set root.

bindings.name: proof_context
bindings.source: context:value — MUST equal the authenticated request context hash for this presentation.

bindings.name: predicate_type
bindings.source: map:predicateTypes[proofType] — MUST equal this document's predicateTypes entry for the proof entry's proofType. One verification key covers four predicate meanings; accepting a proof without pinning this selector lets a proof issued for one meaning satisfy a request for another.

bindings.name: set_root
bindings.source: param:setRoot — predicate-specific: MUST be 0 for accreditation; MUST bind directly for source-of-funds and tax-residency; for sanctions, MUST equal the root independently derived from the signed APR canonicalSet. The resulting value MUST be compared directly with this public input.
bindings.note: NOT covered by the claim-binding preimage (predicate_type, required_0, required_1, flag_required, proof_context, timestamp). A compare routine built from that preimage instead of the pub list misses this field entirely, letting the prover choose its own membership set. It MUST be compared directly.

bindings.name: accumulator_root
bindings.source: policy:accumulatorState.roots[accumulatorEpoch] — MUST be the issuer-published non-revocation root the verifier's accumulator state records for the claimed epoch.

bindings.name: accumulator_epoch
bindings.source: policy:accumulatorState — MUST NOT lag the verifier's current epoch view by more than the policy epoch-lag bound, and MUST NOT be ahead of that view.

bindings.name: timestamp
bindings.source: context:timestamp — MUST equal the authenticated request context timestamp.

bindings.name: current_epoch
bindings.source: policy:accumulatorState.currentEpoch — MUST equal the verifier's own current accumulator epoch view for the proof's issuer.

bindings.name: issuer_public_key_x
bindings.source: policy:issuerAllowlist — the (x, y) key MUST be an exact member of the verifier trust policy's issuer allowlist, and the matched issuer MUST be trusted for this proof type.

bindings.name: issuer_public_key_y
bindings.source: policy:issuerAllowlist — checked together with issuer_public_key_x as one exact allowlist key.
